lastCompletedStory.title: Fail-closed codex auth preflight core (check + decision fn, retire stale notice)

nextStoryContext: codexAuthPreflight({backend, model, authCheck?}) and codexAuthCheck() now live in src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts, unwired (US-002/US-003 wire it into the 3 supervisor worker-dispatch call sites in loop.ts/review.ts/plan-runner.ts and the run.ts orchestrator dispatch site respectively). Decision order inside codexAuthPreflight: backend!=='codex' short-circuits proceed (authCheck never invoked) -> claude-alias model check (/\b(opus|sonnet|haiku)\b/i) fires before authCheck -> authCheck() invoked last, aborting with a 'codex login' message when unauthenticated. Call sites should call codexAuthPreflight AFTER resolving {backend, model} via readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel (same locals already threaded into emitSpawnResolution) and BEFORE building argv via selectAdapter(...).buildSpawnArgv(...); on abort, skip the spawn and surface result.message to the operator/event log instead. The old CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE informational guard and its emitNotice/NoticeEmitter seam were deleted wholesale from spawn-resolution.ts (zero remaining production call sites); emitSpawnResolution now only carries {phase, model, backend, writeEvent?}. test/logging/codex-guard.test.ts was deleted (it only tested the retired notice).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed $CODEX_HOME/auth.json defaults to ~/.codex/auth.json on macOS/Linux (CODEX_HOME override and keyring storage mode exist but are out of scope for this story's presence check), matching the codexAuthCheck implementation.
